product_one_liner.value: Vim's healthcare workflow platform connects providers, payers, EHRs, and developers, bringing data, tools, and applications into clinical workflows at the point of care.
product_one_liner.notes: Vim’s homepage says the platform connects providers, payers, EHRs, and developers and delivers data, tools, and AI-driven apps at the point of care (https://getvim.com/).

pricing_page.notes: Vim has a dedicated Vim Canvas pricing page (https://getvim.com/vim-canvas-pricing).

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Vim’s case studies identify Humana and MyCare Medical as organizations using Vim (https://getvim.com/case-studies/humana; https://getvim.com/case-studies/mycare-medical). | named_customers.0: Vim’s case study identifies Humana as a customer (https://getvim.com/case-studies/humana). | named_customers.1: Vim’s case study identifies MyCare Medical as a customer (https://getvim.com/case-studies/mycare-medical).

employee_band.notes: The press kit reports 132 employees across the U.S. and Israel, which falls in the 101–200 band (https://getvim.com/press-kit).

value.city: New York City and Tel Aviv

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Vim’s press kit lists its headquarters as New York, NY and Tel Aviv (https://getvim.com/press-kit). | hq_country: Vim’s press kit lists headquarters in New York, NY and Tel Aviv, and describes its employees as across the U.S. and Israel; these support the two countries reported (https://getvim.com/press-kit).

founded_year.notes: Vim’s About page says it was founded in 2015 (https://getvim.com/about-us).

eng_blog.notes: Vim Engineering has at least two technical posts describing Vim’s TypeScript practices and a Node.js module: “Writing Scalable Types in TypeScript” and “Using Node.js to Write Safer Bash Scripts.” The former identifies its author as a full-stack engineer and describes Vim’s TypeScript use; the latter describes a module the authors wrote. (https://medium.com/getvim/writing-scalable-types-in-typescript-83b73e1fd578; https://medium.com/getvim/using-node-js-to-write-safer-bash-scripts-ad6a523a5324).

public_docs.notes: Vim Docs has a public navigation linking to platform documentation, how-to guides, VimOS JS, and the VimOS API (https://docs.getvim.com/).

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Vim’s job board has an AI Ops Engineer posting, which is an AI-titled open role (https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/vim/jobs/7820586).

model_provider.value: Heidi Health for the integrated AI-powered ambient scribe; the underlying AI model is not publicly identified.
model_provider.notes: Vim’s announcement describes Heidi Health’s AI-powered ambient scribe as integrated into Vim Connect and available in EHR workflows. The cited announcement names the integrated AI product/provider but does not identify its underlying model (https://getvim.com/news-and-events/vim-and-heidi-health-partner-to-accelerate-innovation-at-the-point-of-care).

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The official Trust Center explicitly says Vim is SOC 2 Type II audited and HIPAA-compliant (https://www.getvim.ai/trust-center). HITRUST is not included because the requested list specifies SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS. | compliance_certs.0: Vim’s official Trust Center names SOC 2 Type II (https://www.getvim.ai/trust-center). | compliance_certs.1: The same Trust Center states Vim is HIPAA-compliant (https://www.getvim.ai/trust-center).

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: PitchBook classifies the July 1, 2021 $24.7M deal as Later Stage VC (Series C), and CB Insights also labels the July 1 round Series C (https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/166321-18; https://www.cbinsights.com/company/getvim/financials). | funding_date: PitchBook dates its reported latest Series C deal to July 1, 2021; the requested YYYY-MM value is 2021-07 (https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/166321-18). CB Insights also identifies July 1, 2021 as the latest Series C round (https://www.cbinsights.com/company/getvim/financials). | funding_amount_usd: PitchBook reports a July 1, 2021 Later Stage VC (Series C) deal for $24.7M, and CB Insights independently identifies July 1, 2021 as Vim’s latest Series C round (https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/166321-18; https://www.cbinsights.com/company/getvim/financials). Funding sources differ on reported figures, so this amount is based on PitchBook’s specific latest-deal entry.

raised_18mo.notes: The cited funding sources put Vim’s latest reported Series C in 2021, before the 18-month window ending 2026-11-09 (https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/166321-18; https://www.cbinsights.com/company/getvim/financials).

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Vim’s Enterprise Account Executive posting says it is hiring 2–3 Enterprise AEs (https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/vim/jobs/7722125).

launched_6mo.notes: The media index’s March 2026 items are research and a conference-related announcement; its later product/workflow launch-type announcement is dated October 20, 2025, before the six-month window beginning 2026-05-09 (https://www.getvim.ai/media).

leadership_change_12mo.notes: LinkedIn profiles identify Dave Boerner as Vim’s Vice President Solutions with a 2026-04-01 start date, and Colin Kemble as Vice President, Account Management & Integrations with a 2026-01-01 start date. Both are VP-level hires within the 12 months before 2026-11-09 (https://linkedin.com/in/davidboerner; https://linkedin.com/in/colin-kemble-aa16a94).
